candidates.buyer_pain: I need proof that an agent action was authorized, evidenced, contained, replayable, and learnable before I let it touch customers, systems, or money.
candidates.credibility_gap: No buyer has yet confirmed that they would pay for this black-box review.
candidates.first_demo_path: Use the E31 paid readiness-review action as a sample: intent contract, evidence sufficiency, authorization decision, sandbox/no-send receipt, claim boundary, CEO KG learning update.
candidates.first_monetization_route: Paid Agent Action Legitimacy Audit / black-box review for teams preparing agent deployments.
candidates.first_validation_path: Owner-approved demo packet shown to a friendly AI operator/consultancy or published as a no-send walkthrough only after approval.
candidates.mvp_artifact: No-send preflight console plus flight-recorder receipt pack for one sample agent action.
candidates.name: Agent Action Black Box
candidates.why_existing_players_fail: Frameworks execute; observability traces; GRC governs policy; identity maps permissions. None naturally connect intent/action/evidence/feedback/learning/business route.
candidates.why_now: Agents are gaining tool, protocol, and payment surfaces faster than institutions can govern them.
candidates.why_y_star_fit: Y* already has evidence boundaries, CEO KG, route reasoning, provider containment, receipts, and closure proofs.
